andalucia.overview: Hiking ranges from the high peaks of the Sierra Nevada to deep limestone gorges, with the Caminito del Rey as the headline route. Pinned to the sheer walls of the Gaitanes Gorge, this moderate walk requires a timed ticket and a shuttle ride to the start. The high mountains offer strenuous day hikes to summits like Mulhacén. The hiking is best in spring and autumn, as summer heat is extreme.

acadia.overview: Granite peaks rise straight from the Atlantic, offering a dense network of day hikes that range from easy lake loops to strenuous iron-rung scrambles up the cliffs. Hikers reach the trailheads by driving or using the park's shuttle system. The park is heavily crowded from summer through October, especially at the Jordan Pond and Cadillac Mountain trailheads, where parking fills early and driving up Cadillac Summit Road needs a reservation.

athens.overview: The mountains ringing the city offer day hikes a short drive from the center. Mount Parnitha, the highest, has moderate trails through pine forests to mountain refuges, while Mount Hymettus has rocky, exposed routes with views over the capital and the Saronic Gulf. Spring and autumn are best, as summer brings dangerous heat and fire-risk trail closures.
